provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: the Tours Mame 1922 reads 'EUS,' where the 1962 prints 'Deus,'; the Tours Mame 1922 reads 'Pontificem,animarum' where the 1962 prints 'Pontificem, animarum'; the Tours Mame 1922 window carries ':' at this point where the 1962 does not; the Tours Mame 1922 sets no pointing after 'fecundasti' where the 1962 sets a colon; recogniser damage in the Tours Mame 1922 text layer at this locus, not variant readings: DOCT. for edocti; EUS, for eius; AIfonsum for alfonsum; Confessérem for confesorem; foecundasti for fecundasti; quzesumus; for quaesumus; eddcti for edocti; bare numeric tokens (printed folio / marginal numbers) dropped from the Tours Mame 1922 reading: 77, 1; conclusion length was not collated: the 1962 prints 'Per Dominum.' and the witness abbreviates the same rubrical cue; one formula at two lengths, which is within the matched tolerance. Corroboration: Pustet Ratisbon 1862, nearest preceding printed-folio marker 506 at text-layer line 70052; text-layer lines 70128-70146 (char-level agreement 0.942 with the 1962 target).

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui per beatum Alfonsum Mariam Confessorem tuum atque Pontificem,
animarum zelo succensum, Ecclesiam tuam nova prole fecundasti: quaesumus;
ut, ejus salutaribus monitis edocti et exemplis roborati, ad te pervenire
feliciter valeamus. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Caelesti, Domine Jesu Christe, sacrificii igne corda nostra in odorem
suavitatis exure: qui beato Alfonso Mariae tribuisti et haec mysteria
celebrare, et per eadem hostiam tibi sanctam seipsum exhibere: Qui vivis et
regnas.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Deus, qui beatum Alfonsum Mariam Confessorem tuum atque Pontificem fidelem
divini mysterii dispensatorem et praeconem effecisti: ejus meritis
precibusque concede; ut fideles tui et frequenter percipiant, et percipiendo
sine fine collaudent. Per Dominum.
